name: cyclevania
description: CycleVania SDK workspace — deterministic procedural metroidvania level generation (Rust core + napi addon + WASM).

scripts.build:wasm-probes: cargo build -p cv-determinism --example determinism_probe --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo build -p cv-core --example core_probe --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.verify:determinism: cargo test -p cv-determinism -p cv-core && npm run verify:wasm-golden
scripts.verify: npm run verify:generated && cargo test && npm run verify:wasm-golden && npm run verify:addon && npm run editor:check && npm run editor:test
